# openwrt_sys_rpc (Data Source)

Low-level access to the /rpc/sys JSON-RPC API. Allows calling any luci.sys* function; e.g. 'hostname', 'uptime', 'net.routes', 'user.getuser', 'process.list', 'wifi.getiwinfo', etc.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `method` (String) JSON-RPC method name to call on /rpc/sys, e.g. 'hostname', 'uptime', 'net.routes', 'user.getuser'.

### Optional

- `params_json` (String) Optional JSON-encoded array of positional parameters to pass to the method, e.g. '["network","lan"]'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID, equal to the method name.
- `result_json` (String) Raw JSON result returned by the RPC call. Use jsondecode() in Terraform to work with it.
